## 🏛️ Data Lakehouse Architecture & 9 Core Fields

To handle tens of thousands of codebases without relying on single-point API limits, the catalog integrates with a multi-connector data lake architecture:

| Field | Target Metric | Primary Provider & Connector | Fallback & Provenance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. Name** | Canonical identifier & display name | GitHub REST API / repos.ecosyste.ms | PyPI / NPM Metadata |
| **2. Canonical Link** | Verified landing page (zero 404s) | GitHub HTTP HEAD & landing checks | Source URL fallback |
| **3. Primary Language** | Dominant programming language | repos.ecosyste.ms (348M repos) | Linguist / Registry classification |
| **4. Latest Update Date** | Publish & commit timestamp | repos.ecosyste.ms / libraries.io | npm time.modified / PyPI upload_time |
| **5. Size (Bytes / MB)** | Unpacked code size | UNPKG `?meta` (JS) / ClearlyDefined (Python) | Git tree size / ecosyste.ms |
| **6. File Count** | Total source file count | UNPKG file tree / ClearlyDefined harvest | Software Heritage / Open Hub |
| **7. Lines of Code (LOC)** | Total, Code, Comment, Blank | SEART GitHub Search (SEART GHS) | CodeTabs API / The Stack v2 |
| **8. Code Modules** | Language package modules | Language AST / Workspace Root counting | Python `**/*.py`, JS `package.json` |
| **9. Documentation** | Markdown & Doc files | Directory listing (`.md`, `.rst`, `docs/`) | Sphinx & ReadTheDocs detection |

Every codebase also carries a **PURL (Package URL)** (e.g. `pkg:github/owner/repo`) and a full `provider_provenance` JSON record for complete reproducibility.

## 🔬 How to Query & Use the Raw CSV Metadata

All structured metadata rendered in this README is also persisted in [**`Awesome_AI_to_AGI.csv`**](./Awesome_AI_to_AGI.csv).

### Query with DuckDB (Instant In-Memory SQL)
```sql
-- Select top AI repos with highest LOC and stars
SELECT name, canonical_source, stars, loc_total, size_mb, latest_update_date
FROM read_csv_auto('Awesome_AI_to_AGI.csv')
WHERE stars > 5000
ORDER BY stars DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

### Load with Python Pandas
```python
import pandas as pd

# Read the metadata CSV
df = pd.read_csv('Awesome_AI_to_AGI.csv')
print(f"Total loaded codebases: {len(df)}")
print(df[['name', 'stars', 'loc_total', 'latest_update_date']].head(10))
```
